text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Over these three years,
Sweep Tosho achieved magnificent results.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When they first met,
she was still just a selfish girl, but—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Familiaaar!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Familiar, why are you in your room!
I told you we were going to test out new magic today!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—As always, she called me her familiar,
spending her days indulging in every selfish whim.
choice_data_list: Sorry! I was organizing the race data, and...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hah!? How pathetic~

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Aaah. Fine, whatever.
Just stay right there.
...Good grief.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Lake☆Attach☆Witch Run!
Familiar—become invincible!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Fufun♪ It was just a test run,
but it seems to have gone pretty well.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Right now, your body is at its peak, and your mind is super strong too!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Well then, let's see the results right away!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, the magic of the genius witch Sweepy
is completely flawless.
Alright, here I gooo!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Bracing for the oncoming pain, I close my eyes. Please, just anything but the hospital—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*click*)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Like I'd hit you with something that looks that painful, dummy.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
That was your punishment for forgetting
your promise to me because of work.
If you do it again, I won't forgive you!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Fufu, but this photo of the familiar squeezing its eyes shut in desperation... Hehehe, so lame...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
No way, nuh-uh♪
Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You really are an idiot, familiar.
As if I'd ever cast the ultimate magic on you.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"...Why can't you understand
that you don't need something like that?!"
